description: Use this when someone asks what size of dining table fits a room or how many people a table seats. Calculates dining tables in four shapes (rectangle, square, round, oval) for a number of people, with the smallest room for each at the minimum (36 in, 914 mm) and comfortable (44 in, 1118 mm) clearance from the table edge to the walls; or, from a room size, the table of each shape with the most seats that fits. Rules: 24 in (snug) or 30 in (comfortable) of table edge per person (Dimensions.com); width 36 in up to 8 people and 42 in for more; one person at each end of a rectangle or oval from 5 people; round diameter = people × edge per person ÷ π; clearances from NKBA Kitchen Planning Guideline 8.

clearance.description: From the table edge to the walls: minimum 36 in (914 mm) to edge past seated guests, comfortable 44 in (1118 mm) to walk past them. Default minimum.

ends.description: Seat one person at each end of a rectangular or oval table that seats more than four. Default true.

room.description: The dining room, for the largest table of each shape that fits.

seats.description: Number of people at the table. Give seats or room, not both.

space.description: Table edge per person: snug 24 in (610 mm), comfortable 30 in (762 mm). Default snug.

width.description: A fixed table width, also the smallest square side and round diameter; default 914 (36 in) for up to 8 people and 1067 (42 in) for more, in millimeters.

name: calculate_dining_table
title: Dining table size calculator
